entries.title: Opened: $1,000, trades only on Vamsi's direction
entries.body:
Start: $1,000 paper cash, Sat Oct 3. Default finish: the Mon Oct 5, 4:00 PM ET close, the same line as the other two books; Vamsi can extend it.
Instruments: stocks, ETFs (leveraged and inverse included), listed options (regular session; buy at the ask, sell at the bid) and spot crypto (24/7). Cash account: no margin, no short selling, no naked option writing.
Process: Vamsi says where to look and how to trade. Each instruction is journaled with the trade it produced, and the stops and exits he sets are enforced at every routine run.

entries.title: Vamsi's strategy: buy support, sell resistance (25-name radar)
entries.body:
Vamsi's instruction (Sat Oct 3): trade high-volatility stocks (his daily names: GPUS, IREN, BTDR); buy at support, sell at resistance, stop under support; keep at least 20 names on the radar with the levels ready; a name reaching its support is the trigger.
Radar: 25 names from Friday's closes (config/radar.json; table in research/radar/2026-10-03.md). Levels are swing lows and highs tested at least twice in the last 120 sessions. Buy zone = support to support + 0.3 ATR; stop = 0.6 ATR under support; sell zone = resistance - 0.3 ATR to resistance. GPUS (R:R 1.2, about $7M traded a day) and BTDR (R:R 1.4) miss the filters and stay on as his names.
Rules (RUNBOOK 2a): buy at a regular-session run from 9:55 AM when a name is inside its buy zone, or touched it this session and held with entry R:R of at least 1.5. Never after it trades through its stop, on an offering or negative-news day, or after 2:55 PM Monday. Up to 4 positions of about $250, at most 2 of them crypto-linked (13 of the 25 move with bitcoin or ether), higher R:R first, settled cash only on Monday. Sell in the sell zone, at the stop, or at the 3:40 PM liquidation Monday (unless the window is extended).
At Friday's close HUT ($89.70) and UMAC ($22.33) sit inside their buy zones; ASTS, ONDS, GLXY, NNE, TEM, SMCI, MSTR, GPUS and CORZ are within 3% above theirs.
This book trades only these instructions; stocks only under this strategy.

entries.title: Backtest: buying the radar's support has no measurable edge (61 stocks, 5 years)
entries.body:
Question from Vamsi: can I read levels, candles, trends and volume well enough? Test: scripts/sr_backtest.py rebuilds the radar's levels each day from the data available at that close (no look-ahead) for all 61 radar candidates over 5 years, then trades the next session. Costs are included, and a stop and target hit on the same day count as the stop.
Live rule (buy the touch of the buy zone; sell at the sell zone, the stop, or after 10 sessions): 2,560 trades, average +0.02R [-0.05, +0.10], +0.13% a trade, 34% winners, stop hit 63%. Random entries on the same stocks with the same stop and target distances: +0.01R. The level adds nothing measurable.
One-session version (sold at that day's close, the Monday-only case): 5,127 trades, -0.05R [-0.07, -0.03], -0.34% a trade.
Rejection candle at the zone, buy the next open: 994 trades, -0.02R; more winners (48%), smaller wins.
Filters (above the 200-day, rising 50-day, support tested 3+ times, quiet or heavy volume on the touch): no subset's interval excludes zero. Best hint: heavy volume on the touch (1.5x the 20-day average), +0.11R (n=387) and +0.20R with the candle (n=94), both inside noise.
By year (touch, 10 sessions): 2022 -0.28R, 2023 +0.17R, 2024 +0.25R, 2025 +0.03R, 2026 -0.10R. The result follows the market, not the levels.
Limits: one way of drawing levels (daily swing points); today's list of popular volatile stocks (survivorship); daily bars can't see intraday reclaims. Full output: research/backtests/sr-2026-10-03.md.

Exit: sell zone, stop traded, or the 3:40 PM liquidation of everything (window ends at the 4:00 PM close unless Vamsi extends it).
Expectation from the backtest (J0005): buying the touch and selling at the same day's close averaged -0.34% a trade after costs, no better than random entries.
